**Which number, and where you found it**

The run id and the command help most. `just report --render --run-id <id>` prints the settings behind any recorded row, and it needs no API key.

**How you checked**

Anything anyone can repeat: a command, a calculation, a line of code that does not do what the text around it claims. "It looks off" is a fine issue too. Say so and I will check.
